title: Composable cost-threads lexicon and Figma asset kit for rollout-aware dashboards
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a compact, reusable lexicon and component kit in Figma for 'cost threads' — composable dashboard strips that surface per-route/model cost, rollouts, and stateful signals. The kit should include token mappings for density, emphasis, and rollout state, accessible color ramps, interaction specs for canary/A-B/paused rollouts, and a small clickable prototype to validate handoff with Frontend and Console PMs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library published with component variants for CostThread (compact, regular, expanded)
Token palette documented: spacing, elevation, color ramps, microcopy scale tied to token names
Interactive prototype demonstrates canary->ramp->pause states with visual and microcopy changes
Accessibility checks: contrast ratios >= WCAG AA for text, focus states documented
Handoff checklist completed and links to PRD/engineering tickets included
